description: This file is a helper module for testing and interacting with a DataBroker system over gRPC, including class definitions for managing DataBroker connections, subscribing to data points, and handling metadata. It contains notable classes such as Databroker and SubscribeRunner with methods for connecting, getting metadata, registering data points, and subscribing to data streams.

classes.name: Databroker
classes.description: A class encapsulating interactions with the DataBroker system, including connection management, metadata handling, datapoint registration, and subscription to data streams.

classes.name: SubscribeRunner
classes.description: A helper class that manages subscription events in a dedicated thread, running an event loop to process incoming data points.

methods.description: Asynchronously closes the gRPC channel.

methods.description: Waits until the gRPC channel state indicates connectivity is ready, with retries.

methods.name: set_float_datapoint(self, name: str, value: float)
